newsitem.title: USA: CFC Intl sees Q3 EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: CFC Intl sees Q3 EPS below estimates.

text.p: CFC International Inc said on Wednesday it expected third-quarter earnings to be below analysts' projections.

"We expect to earn significantly less than the earnings-per-share estimates that have been published for the third quarter of 1996," said Roger Hruby, chairman of CFC International, in a statement accompanying the announcement.
First Call analysts' estimated per-share net income of $0.21, compared with net income of $0.26 in the year-ago third period.

The expected shortfall is due to "product development costs and trial production runs associated with new products, in conjunction with becoming the sole supplier to a major producer of manufactured housing," the company said.
CFC also said a delayed delivery schedule and expenses for its market research in the Pacific Rim will contribute to its lower earnings.
